title: Hachiman live opening checkpoint comparison

replayCoverage.recordedTurns: T1 through T8, including both Virtual Concert party rounds in T5 and T6.
replayCoverage.completedCheckpointMeans: All scripted actions in that checkpoint resolved, not full live-run parity.
replayCoverage.stopPolicy: Stop at the first illegal actor, action, song, resource, selected mask, Highlight, or Concert-context guard.
replayCoverage.validationStatus: Inspect checkpoint status, guardFailure, action events, and shield events for actual progress.

purpose: Deterministic raw damage preview for side-by-side checkpoint inspection. It does not predict game score.

configuration.seedSelection: Default 8 is the first positive seed from a narrow 1-100 check whose J&C Gun roll is critical after the opening target-selection draw. It was not selected by score or total damage.
configuration.wonderT1Persona: Vasuki after a free Persona switch

runnerAdapters.name: Rakunda
runnerAdapters.reason: Vasuki and Janosik use the observed 42.7% Defense reduction tooltip, while the local transferable skill is reference-only.
runnerAdapters.behavior: This script supplies a 42.7% Defense reduction for 3 turns and uses the observed 22 SP cost for both Personas.

runnerAdapters.name: Janosik Tarukaja
runnerAdapters.reason: The recorded T6 cast provides the max-rank base, per-500-Attack scaling, cap, duration, and SP cost.
runnerAdapters.behavior: This script applies 17.1% plus 1.4% per 500 current Wonder Attack, capped at an additional 11.4%, for 3 turns and costs 22 SP.

runnerAdapters.name: Auto-Mataru IV
runnerAdapters.reason: The local catalog has a 9.8% party Attack tooltip but marks the passive reference-only.
runnerAdapters.behavior: This script applies 9.8% party Attack for 2 turns before opening passives.

knownOmissions: Dionysus trait effects are not modeled by the engine.
Vasuki passive Stare, Serpent Bite, and Venomous Spiral continuous damage are not modeled by this checkpoint path.
Universal Theoria has a sourced 33% party Attack and selected-ally 22% damage implementation; later checkpoint use remains unvalidated.
Ichigo Lovesick base damage coefficient and duration are absent from the imported reference, so unsupported damage is omitted.
Berry starts with 180 maximum SP by user request on 2026-09-05; her original screenshot preset records 100 SP.
Natural owner-turn SP recovery applies the guide-sourced base 10, including Concert turns. SP Recovery percentage modifiers remain unapplied pending normalization of their stored conventions.
J&C, Wonder, and Marian use local catalog or built-in default combat stats because no equipped screenshots were supplied for them; Marian starts with 180 maximum SP by user request on 2026-09-05.
Hachiman score conversion, survival bonus, and the actual ending trigger are unverified. Only raw simulated damage is reported.
The simulator internal Action counter is not expected to match the game counter, which includes enemy actions.

Shared Highlight starts from Marian Prosperity and uses user-confirmed ordinary action gains: 17%, or 21% on weakness. The old 93% checkpoint predates this correction; no new result is claimed without a replay.

Virtual Concert doubles charge to 34% normally or 42% on weakness. Berry S1 kill-reset recasts also charge, per user correction. Other repeat/follow-up eligibility and historical 38% intervals remain unresolved.

Wonder now carries the directly observed Cursed Ties profile. Evil Eye automatic application is omitted until its trigger granularity is verified; weapon component stats are not substituted for missing equipped Wonder totals.
The route records the observed Janosik Persona cycles. Janosik Marked, Harmony activation, and visible Matarukaja IV reactivation remain unmodeled.
The recorded live score allocations and missed individual hit frames are not used to force resources, damage, shields, cooldowns, or target state.

If the engine diverges from a recorded checkpoint, the next guarded action may still be legal. The report exposes the simulated state after every action and stops only at the first illegal route action.
